MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 88
   D. 22

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

4. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

5. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 120
   C. 46
   D. 23

9. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 12.5
   C. 5
   D. 25

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

11. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 6

12. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

13. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

14. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
